opening.argument: The process is presented as Bitcoin lending with an expected interest figure, then gives a direct payment instruction: enter an amount, review the expected interest, and send the exact BTC amount to the displayed address. The lending dialog shows interest accrual terms and wallet payment options, while the request screen displays a Bitcoin address and waits for payment. A later screen marks the request payment completed, reinforcing that the requested funding is part of the lending flow. This supports the position that the video promotes an investment pool or lending return scheme. The available evidence does not establish who controlled the address, what return was delivered, or whether the screens show a live transaction.

citations.quote: Enter the amount you wish to lend. Your interest expectancy is also shown for your convenience.
Make sure you send the exact BTC amount to the Bitcoin address displayed
